_what: Drift verdict thresholds (docs/DRIFT.md, DESIGN §1.4). A bucket's config/thresholds.json overrides any key. Points: the total in exam ROWS, a set in PERCENTAGE points of the set.
_sigma_seed: Retrain bar only (retrain/bar.py): {set: rows} of seed-to-seed spread, measured by retrain/noise.py (docs/RETRAIN.md R10); empty = eval-replicate noise only. Never used by drift verdicts.
_r4_reference: Retrain bar only (retrain/bar.py add_reference, rule r4_floor; r7 spec item 6, pre-registered): the candidate against r4's RECORDED calibration replicates (the first `baseline` path found in the pipeline bucket; every copy found is sha256-recorded and compared, a mismatch is a warning; a file whose model digest is not `digest` is refused). `file_sha256` pins the file itself (sha256 of the bytes, 2026-10-17: both bucket copies) — `digest` is the MODEL digest inside it; a copy with another file sha256 (a recalibration written to the same path) is skipped with a warning, none matching = NOT MEASURED. Per set Δ_vs_r4 ≥ −tol (σ from r4's replicates) and the pooled McNemar not significantly worse. No file: the rule passes NOT MEASURED with a warning. `rows_run`: the round whose current arm was r4 (its eval/current/rows.jsonl verdicts feed the report-only 'asks on clear requests' count). `bar: false` reports without gating; null disables. baselines/reference/r4/ is a person's copy (gcloud storage cp) before the Mistral cleanup deletes experiments/mistral/.
